results.title: A Survey on Deep Learning for 2D and 3D Human Pose Estimation
results.content: # A Survey on Deep Learning for 2D and 3D Human Pose Estimation. Human pose estimation is a fundamental task in computer vision and robotics that involves detecting the human body joints from images or videos. This survey provides a detailed review of various methods in 2D and 3D human pose estimation for single-person and multiperson contexts in both image-based and video-based scenarios. In addition, we provide an overview of various evaluation metrics and loss functions commonly used to evaluate the accuracy and robustness of pose estimation models. We then explore key application domains where pose estimation plays an important role. Finally, we survey challenges in human pose estimation, including occlusion, data scarcity, privacy concerns, generalization issues, and model complexity, and suggest potential future research directions. Overall, this review aims to guide researchers in understanding current methods, datasets, and applications, while pointing out open issues and highlighting the future scope of human pose estimation.
